main_source.title: Oil Prices Slide as Global Glut Fears Eclipse Hormuz Attacks
main_source.author: Irina Slav
main_source.quote: At the time of writing, Brent crude was trading at $91.70 per barrel, and West Texas Intermediate was trading at $85.03 per barrel, both down from Monday’s close.

price_basis: Common time-of-writing reported snapshot from the selected article, not a final settlement.
source_scope: Prices were lower while traders focused on projected oversupply; Gulf shipping attacks and safety risks continued. Forecasts of surplus are not certain future outcomes.

corroboration.role: Corroborates surplus expectations and continuing Gulf attacks. Its earlier Brent92.00/WTI85.28 pair at01:02GMT is not used in this graphic.

no_chart: Selected price article has no original quantitative chart needed for this graphic. No decorative numbers or invented chart.
